function.name: run_study_trial
function.description: Run one fresh Newton-Raphson AC trial. Every response reports the network-wide results: convergence, iterations, min/max bus voltage, max line and transformer loading, and voltage violations. Use operation=none for base-case and N-1 reports; a report needs only network_id, max_iter and, for N-1, contingency_line. load_scale multiplies ALL loads' P/Q and observes bus_voltage; line_rating scales one line max_i_ka and observes line_loading; gen_dispatch scales one generator P and observes trafo_loading. A modification needs scale, observation and observation_id; line_rating and gen_dispatch also need element_id, the modified line/generator. Use only ids the task or a tool response gave you. Omit contingency_line (or pass null) for the intact network; an integer takes that line out of service, and 0 is a real line. load_level sets the operating point: every load's P/Q times load_level before the study (omit it for the base load; not with load_scale, which already scales every load). Returns actual measurements, not a fitted answer. status=constraint_violation with metric_valid=true is still a usable measurement: compare voltage_violations with base_case_voltage_violations, which the unmodified case already has.
